definitions.explanation: A written or printed mark used to represent something, such as punctuation, mathematical symbols, or other conventional signs.

examples.japanese: {地図|ちず}の{記号|きごう}の{意味|いみ}を{調|しら}べた。
examples.english: I looked up the meaning of the map symbols.

examples.japanese: {数学|すうがく}では{様々|さまざま}な{記号|きごう}を{使|つか}う。
examples.english: Various symbols are used in mathematics.

examples.japanese: パスワードには{記号|きごう}を{含|ふく}めてください。
examples.english: Please include symbols in your password.

notes:
TYPES OF SYMBOLS:
・{句読点|くとうてん} (punctuation marks)
・{数学|すうがく}{記号|きごう} (mathematical symbols: +, -, ×, ÷, =)
・{地図|ちず}{記号|きごう} (map symbols)
・{音楽|おんがく}{記号|きごう} (musical notation)
・{化学|かがく}{記号|きごう} (chemical symbols: H, O, Na)

COMPUTING:
・{特殊|とくしゅ}{記号|きごう} (special characters)
・{記号|きごう}を{入力|にゅうりょく}する (to input symbols)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・マーク (mark - loanword)
・シンボル (symbol - loanword)
・{符号|ふごう} (code, sign - technical)
・{印|しるし} (mark, sign - general)
